trickyParts: Referrer-Policy is same-origin, not the plan's no-referrer: under no-referrer a browser sends Origin: null on the page's own form posts, which the exact-origin check refuses.
The account switch is a GET link (/approve/<record>?switch=1) because the CSP's form-action 'self' governs a form submission's redirect, which would block a POST that redirected to the provider.

Chromium keeps __Host-/Secure cookies on plain http://127.0.0.1; Go's cookiejar does not, so the Go helpers send them explicitly; Playwright's context.cookies(url) drops them for non-localhost http, so the spec reads context.cookies().
